scene.ko: 친구가 갑자기 회사에서 정리 해고를 당했다고 털어놓자, 섣불리 조언하기보다 이야기를 들어 주며 공감하고 위로한다.

lines.en: Hey, you've been really quiet tonight. Are you okay?
lines.ko: 야, 오늘 너 계속 조용하다. 괜찮아?
alt: You're so quiet tonight. Is everything okay?
Hey, you don't seem like yourself tonight. What's going on?

lines.en: Not really. I got laid off on Friday. They cut my whole team.
lines.ko: 별로. 금요일에 잘렸어. 우리 팀을 통째로 없앴대.

lines.en: Oh, Kevin. I'm so sorry. That must have been such a shock.
alt: Oh no, Kevin. I'm really sorry. That must have been a huge shock.
Kevin, I'm so sorry. You must be in shock.

lines.en: Yeah. I keep thinking I should have seen it coming.
lines.ko: 응. 미리 눈치챘어야 했는데, 그 생각만 계속 들어.

lines.en: Hey, don't blame yourself. It sounds like it had nothing to do with your work.
lines.ko: 야, 자책하지 마. 들어 보니까 네가 일을 못해서 그런 게 전혀 아니잖아.
alt: Please don't be so hard on yourself. They cut a whole team. It wasn't about you.

lines.en: I know, but I'm still freaking out. Rent's due next month, and I have no idea what's next.
lines.ko: 알아, 그래도 너무 불안해. 다음 달 월세도 내야 하는데, 앞으로 어떻게 될지 하나도 모르겠어.

lines.en: That makes total sense. Anyone would be worried. You don't have to figure everything out tonight.
lines.ko: 당연히 그렇지. 누구라도 걱정될 거야. 오늘 밤에 다 해결하려고 안 해도 돼.
alt: Of course you're worried. Anyone would be. You don't need to have it all figured out right now.

lines.en: Thanks. I guess I just needed to say it out loud.
lines.ko: 고마워. 그냥 누구한테 털어놓고 싶었나 봐.

lines.en: I'm glad you told me. And whenever you're ready, I'm happy to look over your resume. Or we can just grab dinner.
lines.ko: 말해 줘서 고마워. 그리고 준비되면 언제든 이력서 봐 줄게. 아니면 그냥 밥이나 먹자.
alt: I'm really glad you told me. When you're ready, I can help with your resume, or we can just get dinner.

lines.en: I'd like that. Maybe dinner first, though.

expressions.note: Don't be so hard on yourself 도 비슷한 말
상대의 감정이 당연하다고 인정해 줄 때

expressions.en: You don't have to figure everything out ___.
expressions.note: figure out = 답을 찾다 · 부담을 덜어 줄 때
